name: Mangrai
role: Founder of the Mangrai Dynasty and the Kingdom of Lan Na
contribution: The 25th king of Ngoenyang and the first king of Lan Na.
legacy: This person was the 25th king of Ngoenyang and the first king of Lan Na

checks.lead: Mangrai (Northern Thai: ᨻᩕ᩠ᨿᩣᨾᩢ᩠ᨦᩁᩣ᩠ᨿ; Thai: มังราย; c. 1238–1311) was the 25th king of Ngoenyang (r. 1261–1292) and the first king of Lan Na (r. 1292–1311). He established a new city, Chiang Mai, as the capital of the Lan Na Kingdom (1296–1558).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
